citation.title: Plasma performance and operational space with an RMP-ELM suppressed edge
citation.authors: C. Paz-Soldan, S. Gu, N. Leuthold, P. Lunia, P. Xie, M.W. Kim, S.K. Kim, N.C. Logan, J.-K. Park, W. Suttrop, Y. Sun, D.B. Weisberg, M. Willensdorfer, et al. (ASDEX Upgrade, DIII-D, EAST, KSTAR Teams)

topic: Multi-device database (AUG, DIII-D, EAST, KSTAR) of stationary RMP-ELM-suppressed operating points, pedestal limits, and confinement regression
own_question: What operational space and global performance do RMP-ELM-suppressed plasmas show across devices, and how does confinement scale?
actual_method_and_evidence: Retrospective, manually curated stationary windows. KSTAR data come from 2016–2019, with equilibria recomputed. Confinement is fitted by KDE-weighted log-linear regression on random 90/75/60% subsets. The extracted text notes that Ti often exceeds Te, but it does not specify the ion species or the diagnostic. There is no CES chord analysis, no BES/ECEI, no time-resolved prediction, and no KSTAR 2022 data.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Across these devices, much RMP-ELM-suppressed pedestal data has Ti above Te, attributed to ion-heating dominance and limited ECH.
claim_checks.qualification: Database-level observation only. It is not KSTAR 2022, the Ti diagnostic and species are unstated, and it is not evidence about the CES chord.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The analysis uses stationary time-window averages with no nowcasting or report timing.
validation_if_relevant: Random-subset regression is used for exponent uncertainty, not for predictive holdout. There is no untouched-data test.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as support for CES nowcasting, BES/ECEI utility, or 10 ms computation.
Do not treat Fig. 5(b) Ti as carbon-impurity CES on our chord.
Do not extend the database findings to KSTAR 2022.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, this paper could offer optional context on the KSTAR RMP pedestal operating regime. It provides no method or evidence for our question, so exclusion is likely.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
